resources.title: App resources
resources.hint: View visual-omp CPU, RAM and measurement scope.
resources.scope: Includes visual-omp's main, renderer, GPU and utility processes. Excludes omp engines, tools, remote models and other applications.
resources.cpuScope: CPU is the app's share of total logical CPU capacity (0% to 100%), averaged between samples. Process changes and missing measurements require another sample.
resources.memoryScope: RAM sums process working sets. Shared memory pages may be counted more than once.
resources.history: Updates every 2 seconds while visible, with up to 30 samples over 60 seconds. Hiding pauses sampling and clears history. Returning starts a fresh CPU baseline. A question mark means unavailable.
